mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the channels was most worthwhile because the panels explained how an electrical change moves along the fibre without one ion travelling the whole way.

leastWorthwhile.text: Joining the prepared parts was the least interesting choice: it was the only offered combination and followed directly from the goal, though the finished picture added a new detail.

surprise.text: I was surprised that no single ion needs to travel the whole length of the fibre.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt arbitrary. The pictures and goals explained where the parts belonged, although the channel fitting relied on the offered pairing rather than me discovering compatibility.

continue.text: Yes, I'd try another chapter to see how nerve messages affect other parts of the body. The passing electrical change and the gap between cells made me curious.
